For 2011-2017: participation banks constituted as a category within the general Banking Law No. 5411, Resmi Gazete 01.11.2005 No. 25983; the dedicated Council of Ministers Decree 83/7506 of 16.12.1983 on Special Finance Houses (RG 19.12.1983 No. 18256) and its amendments were repealed when the special finance houses were brought under Law 5411 | isarder.org/2020/vol.12_issue.2_article31.pdf ; tkbbegitim.org.tr (Katilim bankalarinin bankacilik sektorundeki yeri ve onemi)
note: BORDERLINE, JUDGEMENT RECORDED - IN-WINDOW CHANGE NOT FLAGGED IN THE HANDOFF. Turkiye had a dedicated instrument from 1983 (Decree 83/7506) until it was superseded in 2005, and again from 14.09.2019 (BDDK Teblig). Between those dates participation banks were one of three statutory bank categories inside the general Banking Law 5411, with no dedicated chapter. That is genuinely ambiguous: more than Guinea's single enabling article, less than Jordan's dedicated chapter. Rule 7 requires the lower value, so 2011, 2014 and 2017 are coded 0 at medium confidence. SENSITIVITY: if Law 5411's participation-bank provisions are counted as a dedicated framework, Turkiye becomes 1 in all four rounds and the in-window change disappears. Report this one line.
